artists.name: Łaszewo
artists.bio: Łaszewo’s Matthew Ehrlich, Keeva Bouley, and Justin De La Fuente originally came together in Santa Barbara, California under unexpected circumstances in 2018. When Justin heard Keeva singing through her open apartment window, he immediately knocked on her door and the rest was history. Since then, they have continued to rise and grow into one of the most exciting and dynamic electronic pop acts. Łaszewo’s 2025 has been off to a hot start with their viral breakout record “messy,” which has garnered millions of streams, hundreds of thousands of UGC, and continues to top the global, Billboard, and dance radio charts. Their follow up single, “HIGHJACK (right back)” with A$AP Rocky and Alok is an explosive and emotionally charged anthem that is already on track for similar global success. Additionally, the trio made their Red Rocks debut earlier this year with a performance that marked a career-defining moment and showcased their signature fusion of emotional songwriting and high-energy production. They are also on track for a sold out US fall run in San Francisco, Chicago, and Denver, as well as embarking on their debut EU tour in December. Łaszewo's two producer and female lead vocalist setup is unique to the electronic landscape. Their diverse talent, unique sonic identity, and charismatic stage presence continues to allow them to be a rising force in the electronic-pop scene and captivate audiences globally along the way in 2025.

artists.name: Electric Feels
artists.bio: Electric Feels is a high energy experiential dance party that plays everything from Indie Rock to Electronic Dance music. Imagine dance music with big rock moments and a ton of singalongs. It's a fun mix of original tracks, remixes and some of our own edits to create a super fun experience spanning from nostalgia to modern. It's a party with a festival feel.

artists.name: Ben Böhmer
artists.bio: Ben Böhmer is a driven composer and producer, constantly bringing new ideas to life through his music. Over the past decade, he has dedicated himself to honing a craft that allows him to express deep, complex emotions. His breakthrough debut album, Breathing, explored grief, while its follow-up, 2021’s Begin Again, delved into themes of separation. The success of these records - more than 1 billion streams - and his ability to connect with audiences in a live setting, performing over 200 shows in 2022 alone, cemented his place as a standout artist.

artists.name: it's murph
artists.bio:
it’s murph is a Nashville-based electronic producer crafting dance music that’s meant to be felt as much as it’s heard. Rooted in emotion but built for movement, his sound lives at the intersection of euphoric melody, gritty low-end, and expansive atmosphere — pulling listeners into moments that feel both intimate and anthemic.

Driven by the belief that music is a multi-sensory experience, it’s murph creates records designed to unlock something deeper: a memory, a feeling, a shared release on the dance floor. His productions balance warmth and edge, pairing melodic progressions with driving grooves that keep crowds locked in while leaving space to breathe.

Blending influences from tech house, bass-forward dance, and melodic electronic music, his sound draws inspiration from artists like Fred again.., Cloonee, and Chris Lake, while remaining distinctly his own. Whether in headphones or under strobe lights, it’s murph’s music invites listeners to step outside themselves and fully immerse in the moment.

As his catalog continues to grow, it’s murph is carving out a lane defined by emotional energy, forward-thinking production, and a deep connection to the people on the other side of the speakers.

artists.name: DJ Trixie Mattel
artists.bio:
Trixie Mattel is an American singer, actor, drag queen and recognized “Skinny Legend.” Trixie is the winner of “RuPaul’s Drag Race All Stars” season 3 (originally competing on season 7). She is also a Billboard Heatseekers #1 charting recording artist, a wildly successful touring act, and one half of a comic duo with Katya on YouTube (“UNHhhh” & Netflix's "I Like To Watch").

She has released the acclaimed albums, ‘Two Birds,’ ‘One Stone’, ‘Barbara’ and the double LP ‘The Blonde and Pink Albums’ to acclaim from Rolling Stone, Billboard, People, Vogue, NPR and more, and has secured high-profile performance slots on Jimmy Kimmel Live! and at Austin City Limits & Stagecoach.

She most recently has taken her Solid Pink Disco live DJ tour across the country, making her one of the hottest DJs on the touring circuit today, with additional appearances at Coachella, OutLoud, and opening for Chappell Roan.

This year sees the release of an official remix of Jennifer Lopez’s “Play”, new original music, and DJ festival appearances all over the world.

artists.name: bad juuju
artists.bio: Seamlessly weaving between swirling psychedelic worlds, percussive intensity, and deep bass frequencies, bad juuju moves crowds with her eclectic approach rooted in club sensibilities. As a member of rising San Francisco-based DJ collective Vitamin1000 and resident on Voices Radio (UK), she crafts immersive dancefloor experiences through textural polyrhythms and low-end heavy selections. Equally an artist and community leader, bad juuju co-curates the experimental party series Fluxions alongside her CYBER1A duo partner Vertigo and organizes Vitamin1000’s yearly campout festival, VITARAVE. With appearances on world-renowned stages such as Keep Hush & Portola Music Festival, bad juuju continues to build recognition as a compelling new voice in electronic music.

artists.name: The xx
artists.bio:
The xx - Romy Madley Croft, Oliver Sim and Jamie Smith - formed in London in 2005. Their debut album xx (2009) reached number three in the UK and won the Mercury Music Prize, while its follow-up Coexist (2012) topped the UK chart and continued their global success. Together, the two albums have sold more than four million copies worldwide.

In 2017, the band returned with I See You, a bold and expansive evolution recorded across New York, Texas, Reykjavík, Los Angeles and London. It debuted at number one in the UK and number two in the US.

All three members have since developed acclaimed solo careers: Jamie xx with his GRAMMY- and Mercury-shortlisted albums In Colour (2015) and In Waves (2024); Oliver Sim with Hideous Bastard (2022); and Romy with her celebrated debut Mid Air (2023), which earned BRIT and GRAMMY nominations.

In 2025, The xx announced their reunion to begin work on a fourth studio album and confirmed major live performances at Coachella and Primavera Sound in 2026.

artists.name: Lane 8
artists.bio:
Once dubbed the king of “dreamy backrub house”, Lane 8 has been making hips swing and sandals shuffle since his breakthrough DJ set in the empty dining room of a San Francisco pork restaurant back in 2012.

Founder of the This Never Happened label and touring concept, since 2016 he has nobly enabled thousands of music lovers worldwide to have IRL, unrecorded, body-transcending, life-affirming and soul-bonding communal dance experiences without phone distractions.

With five albums under his belt, his dreamy melodic sound has drawn influence from tough 90s hip hop, the sugar rush of the EDM heyday, the sleek European techno of labels like Kompakt, oddball electronica, the occasional dash of neo-trance noodles and his boyhood love of Pink Floyd - to mark just a few of his influences.

Outside of music, he likes biking, hiking, tart blueberries, family time, sleeping and eating food.

He can occasionally be found typing on his phone to tell our beloved TNH community that it’s great when we get off our phones and just experience what is going on around us.

artists.name: The Strokes
artists.bio:
The Strokes are a multi-platinum American rock band formed in New York City in 1998, consisting of Julian Casablancas (lead vocals), Nick Valensi (guitar, keyboard, backing vocals), Albert Hammond Jr. (guitar, keyboard, backing vocals), Nikolai Fraiture (bass) and Fabrizio Moretti (drums, percussion).

In 2001, the band released their debut album, titled ‘Is This It’. It was certified platinum in the U.S. & UK and received gold certification in a myriad of other countries around the world. Their sophomore effort, ‘Room On Fire’ was released in 2003, and reached gold status in the U.S. and platinum once again in the UK.

Subsequent full-length releases came with ‘First Impressions Of Earth’, (2006), ‘Angles’ (2011), and ‘Comedown Machine’ (2013). Their most recent studio recording was an EP released in the summer of 2016, entitled ‘Future Present Past’ via Julian Casablancas’ own Cult Records label. The band is presently an RCA recording artist via a venture with Cult Records.

artists.name: PinkPantheress
artists.bio:
PinkPantheress is a multi-platinum recording artist, songwriter, and producer. On an upward trajectory since 2021, PinkPantheress introspective lyrics, and ability to create infectious beats have garnered her a dedicated fan base. Following her critically acclaimed debut mixtape ‘To hell with it’, and international sleeper hit 'Pain' (1-Billion Streams), 2022 saw the rising star win BBC Music’s Sound of 2022, grace the cover of The Face whilst catching the attention of British Vogue where she was the only musician featured on the prestigious Vogue 25 list.

2023 saw PinkPantheress’ Boy's a Liar Pt. 1 & Pt. 2" (1-Billion Streams) take the world by storm, spending an impressive 22 weeks in the Billboard Hot 100 (peaking at No.3), 28 weeks on the UK OCC singles chart (peaking at No.2) and charting #1 in several Spotify & Apple Music charts and has recently received double platinum status in the US. In November 2023, PinkPantheress released her highly anticipated debut album ‘Heaven knows’ which NME called “the blueprint for the future of British pop” whilst New York Times described the debut as “an effervescent collection of infectious hooks with a sound that crosses Y2K aesthetics with the boldness of contemporary hyperpop.”

Last year, PinkPantheress embarked on her biggest headline tour to date, the Capable of Love tour. Her sold-out show at Alexandra Palace earned glowing reviews, with The Guardian and NME awarding it 4*, while The Forty-Five praised, “The expectations for a show this size are bound to be high, but Pantheress goes above and beyond to make it one to remember.” The acclaim continued across the North American leg, where Exclaim! hailed her as a “low-key superstar”, and Rolling Stone declared, “A star is born.”

Her latest mixtape, Fancy That sees PinkPantheress lean into British pop culture, whilst embracing all things fun and kitschy as she embraces a new level of intimacy with her audience. Fancy That is testament to PinkPantheress’ ear, featuring samples and interpolations from Panic! at the Disco to Jessica Simpson to Basement Jaxx as she seamlessly blends classics and hidden gems with her signature earworm production. Pitchfork rated the mixtape an 8.0 whilst The Guardian gave it a 4* rating. 2025 saw PinkPantheress gain her first GRAMMY Nominations with Illegal (Best Dance Pop Recording) and Fancy That (Best Dance/Electronic Album)

Since stepping onto the scene, PinkPantheress has graced the covers of The Gentlewoman, i-D, The Face, and Rolling Stone UK, while also starring in campaigns for Marc Jacobs Heaven, Starface, Bose, and Apple. Most recently, she was honoured in Forbes' 30 Under 30 list and crowned Producer of the Year at the Billboard Women in Music Awards.

With each achievement, PinkPantheress continues to mesmerize and dominate, solidifying her status as a force to be reckoned with in the music industry.
